# Jarvis March Algorithm in Forth

Here's an implementation of the Jarvis March (Gift Wrapping) algorithm for computing convex hulls in Forth:

```forth
\ Convex Hull using Jarvis March Algorithm
\ Points are stored as (x y) pairs on the stack

\ Point structure: x y
\ Distance function between two points
: dist2 ( x1 y1 x2 y2 -- dx dy )
    2dup - swap 2dup - swap 2swap - swap - ;

\ Cross product of three points (p1, p2, p3)
\ Returns positive if counter-clockwise turn, negative if clockwise
: cross-product ( x1 y1 x2 y2 x3 y3 -- cross )
    2over 2over 2over 2swap 2swap 2swap - * - * ;

\ Find the point with minimum y-coordinate (and minimum x if tie)
: find-min-y-point ( -- x y )
    >r
    begin
        dup r@ < while
            2drop r> r>
        repeat
    r> drop ;

\ Check if point p3 is to the left of line formed by p1 and p2
: is-left-turn ( x1 y1 x2 y2 x3 y3 -- flag )
    cross-product 0 > ;

\ Jarvis March algorithm implementation
: jarvis-march ( points-array size -- hull-points-array hull-size )
    \ Find the starting point (leftmost lowest point)
    2dup find-min-y-point
    2drop
    
    \ Initialize variables for hull construction
